gloss: to skim over; to read without paying close attention

definitions.gloss: to skim over; to read without paying close attention; to read and let pass
definitions.explanation: To read text superficially without engaging deeply with the content, or to read something and deliberately not react to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{流|なが}す。
⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{読|よ}み{流|なが}してしまった。
examples.english: It was a long email, so I just skimmed through it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{読|よ}み{流|なが}さないで⟦ちゃんと→ちゃんと：02359_chanto⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧ほしい。
examples.english: It's important content, so I'd like you to read it properly and not just skim over it.

notes:
A compound verb of ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ ('to read') + ⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧ ('to let flow, to let pass'). The ⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧ component conveys the sense of letting the content 'flow by' without absorbing it. This can be intentional (deliberately not engaging) or unintentional (failing to pay attention).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{流|なが}す: to skim an article
- ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{流|なが}す: to skim an email
- さらっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{読|よ}み{流|なが}す: to casually skim through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{斜|なな}め{読|よ}み→斜め読み：22744_nanameyomi⟧: skimming, speed reading — a noun describing the act of reading diagonally/quickly
- ⟦{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばす→読み飛ばす：06850_yomitobasu⟧: to skip over (parts of text) — implies actively skipping sections entirely
- ⟦{流|なが}し{読|よ}み→流し読み：21428_nagashiyomi⟧: skimming — a noun with the same meaning, with reversed word order
